answer: I would anchor trust in Recorded battlefield guide certification with battlefield guides attestation. With a certification guides renew after assessed walks, a single vault check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the glacier compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the tide of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
